name: Techex Communications
summary: Melbourne business ISP ('Best Business Broadband', NOC, 24x7 helpdesk, hosting); techex.net.au redirected to techex.com.au by 2002; defunct (TECHEX COMMUNICATIONS PTY LIMITED (NOW DESTRA COMMUNICATIONS PTY LTD), ACN 091 592 602).

events.details: Acquired by Destra Corporation (6 Oct 2004). The company was then renamed Destra Communications (same ACN) — a rename, not a third-party resale; techex.com.au folded into Destra by Dec 2005.

refs.label: Deal terms; entity later renamed Destra Communications Pty Ltd.
